programmes.d: Authorities charge an Oklahoma doctor for his wife's death.
Months after a woman and her husband come down with the same mysterious illness, the woman dies after experiencing the same symptoms; old recordings reveal the twisted truth about her demise.
When a woman is found murdered in her bed, her husband and her son accuse each other of being the killer.
Years after a Montana man is found dead, his son opens up a box of case files to find out what really happened.
The sister of a man who died after robbing a bank when a bomb that was placed around his neck detonated talks about the case.
Investigators search for a New Mexico mechanic who has been missing for eight years.

Recently uncovered pages from John Hinckley Jr.'s diary, which he began writing after he was arrested for trying to assassinate President Ronald Reagan; an interview with the officer who questioned Hinckley after the attempted assassination.
Police begin to doubt a man's claim that his wife was murdered by a friend.
A father in Hawaii tackles setback after setback in his fight for justice for his murdered daughter.
When two tragic deaths occur within one week of each other in a wealthy city in California, families begin to wonder what happened inside a beachfront mansion.
Money and greed tear two close-knit California families apart.
As a murder victim's sisters dedicate themselves to finding the killer, an unexpected source turns the case upside down.

When Leslie Neulander dies after what appears to be an accidental fall in the shower in her New York home, two friends join forces to seek justice on her behalf; insiders speak out on the latest twists and the final chapter in the case.
A teenager's life is turned upside down by a shocking discovery as what seems like a fatal accident reveals itself to be something much more disturbing.
A young woman is found dead in an empty warehouse parking lot in Miami -- just four days after her wedding.
When 16-year-old Britney Ujlaky disappears, a small town in Nevada bands together to track down a potential suspect - an unknown cowboy; soon, their focus turns to someone much closer to Britney.

While responding to a house fire in New Jersey, firefighters discover the burned remains of the homeowner in the basement; new interviews and legal developments about the latest twists and turns in the case.
When a California housewife is murdered in broad daylight, the suspected killer claims it was a burglary gone awry.

A mother of two mysteriously vanishes from her parents' Michigan home while going to check the mailbox, leaving her phone and identification behind; police declare her dead without discovering a body.
A woman's disappearance tears her young children apart; a sting operation catches an unlikely villain.
The parents of a missing South Carolina woman speak out about her disappearance.
Investigators follow the trail of a seemingly untraceable late-night call as they search for the killer of businesswoman Peggy Nadell.
